clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, hunters harvest Plainstrider Kidney for Kalimdor's unusual brewing traditions. The organ is unappetizing to most travelers, yet essential to an exotic brew.

The vast, arid plains of the Barrens are home to tall, flightless plainstriders. Hunters often take their feathers and meat for tools and simple rations, while Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet seeks their internal organs for another purpose. Drohn says plainstrider kidneys are needed to recreate Chen Stormstout's legendary potent ale. He claims the kidneys give the brew a unique kick, in a tradition passed down through an unconventional line of brewmasters.
